text: View/preview the output of a node
Old network
As of Houdini 20.5, use
Copernicus nodes
instead of Compositing nodes. Though both networks still exist, the Compositing network is now designated as
COP Network - Old
. The Compositing network and its nodes will be deprecated and then removed in a future Houdini release.
View the output of the node in the compositing viewer
See
how to use the image viewer pane
Use a background image in the viewer to help you judge opacity
In a compositing viewer pane, open the right side toolbar and click
Display Options or press
to open the Display Options window.
Use the controls on the
Background

tab to load a
      background image.
View the output of a node as a flipbook in
MPlay
Press

on the node tile in the network editor and
      choose
Flipbook

. You can also flipbook reduced resolution
      versions of the image.
You can press

to cancel the generation of the
      flipbook.
You can save the flipbook frames by choosing

File ▸ Save
      Sequence
in MPlay.
Keep the output of a node visible in a floating window
Press

on the node tile in the network editor and
      choose
Preview Full

. You can also preview reduced
      resolution versions of the image, or an icon-sized thumbnail.

title: View/preview the output of a node
